The '''A-B-C Islands''' (Japanese: '''イロハ諸島''' ''Iroha Archipelago'') are an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive group of islands located off the coast of [[Hoenn]], between [[Lilycove City]] and [[Mossdeep City]]. They appeared in ''[[AG095|The Evolutionary War!]]''.

{{pkmn|Trainer}}s who live on these islands have been engaged in an intense rivalry with each other over {{p|Clamperl}}'s evolutionary line: with Island C believing {{p|Huntail}} are stronger, while Island B considers {{p|Gorebyss}} the stronger [[Evolution]].

On Island A, [[Nurse Joy]] operates a [[Pokémon Center]], which is also home to a [[Pokémon academy|school]]. The other two islands have transporter hubs connected to the Center, allowing for Trainers to transfer their Pokémon for treatment wherever they are. On Island B, [[Deep Sea Scale|DeepSeaScale]]s can be found and used to [[Evolution|evolve]] Clamperl into Gorebyss, while on Island C, [[Deep Sea Tooth|DeepSeaTeeth]] can be found and used to evolve Clamperl into Huntail. Racing their Huntail and Gorebyss between the islands, as a result, is a common occurrence for the Trainers who reside there.

Known residents of the trio of islands include [[Nancy]] from Island C, while {{OBP|Keith|AG095}} and {{OBP|Midori|AG095}} live on Island B.

==Trivia==
* The reefs off the shores of these islands resemble particular katakana characters. Island A's reefs make an ''I'' (イ), Island B's make a ''Ro'' (ロ) while Island C's make a ''Ha'' (ハ). This (along with the name of the archipelago) is a reference to {{wp|Iroha}}, a traditional way of grouping kana characters. This is somewhat equivalent to western ABC's.
*In the real world, the Dutch Caribbean Islands of {{wp|Aruba}}, {{wp|Bonaire}}, and {{wp|Curaçao}} are commonly known as the "A-B-C Islands."
